title: Submit a valid contact enquiry
description: A visitor can complete the enquiry form with valid details and receive a success confirmation with the form reset. Use the contact form test ids: enquiry-full-name, enquiry-email, enquiry-phone, enquiry-address, enquiry-course, enquiry-college-name, enquiry-how-heard, enquiry-preferences, enquiry-submit, and enquiry-success. In TestSprite E2E mode, placeholder emails such as {{LOGIN_USER}} are normalized locally and no real Supabase/webhook submission is made.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact-us
Fill in the name field with a valid full name
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the phone field with a valid phone number
Fill in the address field with a valid address
Select a course value
Fill in the college name field with a valid college name
Select a how-heard value
Fill in the preference fields with valid details
Submit the enquiry form
Verify a success confirmation is visible
Verify the form fields are reset

Verify the embedded office map is displayed

title: Show required-field validation on contact enquiry
description: A visitor who submits the enquiry form without required details sees validation feedback and the form is not submitted. Use enquiry-submit and assert enquiry-error is visible. The form has noValidate so app validation appears instead of browser-native validation.

steps.description: Navigate to /contact-us
Submit the enquiry form without entering required details
Verify required-field validation errors are visible
Verify no success confirmation is visible
